newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-TEENAGER KOBE BRYANT WINS SLAM DUNK CONTEST.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-TEENAGER KOBE BRYANT WINS SLAM DUNK CONTEST.

text.p: Teenager Kobe Bryant fulfilled a childhood dream on Saturday by winning the NBA All-Star weekend Slam Dunk Contest.

Bryant, who spurned college to enter the NBA at 18 years old, executed a through-the-leg dunk, moving from left to right for a final-round score of 49, easily outpointing Michael Finley and Chris Carr.

"I saw J.R. (Rider) do it at a dunk contest a couple of years back," said Bryant about his winning rim rocker. "I was in practice one day, working on it, doing it from different angles. I did it down the middle.
"I thought it would be something fun to do," added Bryant, who said he wanted to win the Slam Dunk Contest "ever since I was a little kid."
He was only five years old when the NBA held its first slam dunk event in 1984.
The biggest cheer of the event came on an attempt that missed by Finley, who bounced the ball and did a cartwheel before catching it and taking it to the rim.

"I've never seen it before, so I didn't know what the heck was going on," Bryant said of Finley's failed dunk. "I saw him do a cartwheel. I knew he might have something up his sleeve. I didn't know what."
